about: Functions a Gleo AI agent calls to read the MapRibbon channel. Each maps to a read-only content URI of kr.tedin.maptalkdrive; the answer is the JSON column of the returned rows (maptalk.ribbon/1 or maptalk.route/1). Written in JSON Schema function-calling form; Gleo's own schema review and connection are pending.

functions.name: get_route_ribbons
functions.description: Ribbons on the current route in driving order: one per road facility (tunnel, junction, toll gate, camera) and one per SEGMENT, a stretch of about 2 km of open road between them (hard braking, stops, and weather graded by what cars did: wipers on or fast, fog lights front or rear, low beams in daylight, wet road at 3 C or below as iceRiskRate, outsideTempC as context). Each says whether the last 15 to 180 minutes of cars behaved differently from usual there (deviation NONE, SOME, HIGH), why (metric, value, usual value), how many cars that is based on, and when the most recent of them passed (window.lastMs, rounded down to 5 minutes). Places with fewer than three cars are NOT_ENOUGH and must not be described as usual.

route.description: Route id. Omit for the route on screen. SY60E: Seoul-Yangyang Expressway Inje IC to Yangyang JC. N44E: National Route 44 over Hangyeryeong Pass, Inje to Yangyang.

functions.name: get_next_unusual
functions.description: The next facility or segment ahead on the route where cars recently behaved differently from usual, with its distance from the given position. Returns no row when nothing ahead is different.

along_m.description: Current position along the route, in metres from its start.

route.description: Route id. Omit for the route on screen. SY60E: Seoul-Yangyang Expressway Inje IC to Yangyang JC. N44E: National Route 44 over Hangyeryeong Pass, Inje to Yangyang.

functions.name: get_route_shape
functions.description: How the route bends, cut into stretches of STRAIGHT (radius 2 km or more), CURVE (500 m to 2 km) and SHARP (under 500 m, slow down from 100 km/h) with the tightest radius of each; the hairpins inside them (where the heading turns 120 degrees or more within 200 m), each with its position, radius and turn; plus the anchors the ribbons hang on (facilities and segments).

route.description: Route id. Omit for the route on screen. SY60E: Seoul-Yangyang Expressway Inje IC to Yangyang JC. N44E: National Route 44 over Hangyeryeong Pass, Inje to Yangyang.
